name: TENET5 QUANTANIUM Design Contract
release_notes: 1.2.0: TWO-FONT LOCK (Daniel directive 2026-04-27). Site renders in EXACTLY two webfont-loaded faces — Atkinson Hyperlegible (sans/display/serif slot, body, headlines, links) and IBM Plex Mono (mono/labels/eyebrows). All other faces (Inter, Helvetica, Iowan Old Style, Space Grotesk, OpenDyslexic, system-ui) stripped from --slate-font-* stacks. Both fonts loaded via single Google Fonts @import for cross-platform parity. Closes the 'looks different on Mac' drift class. 1.1.0: rebrand SLATE -> QUANTANIUM contract; add --quantanium-* pipeline namespace; add Atkinson Hyperlegible accessible reading mode toggle.
purpose: Single canonical design-token contract for tenet-5.github.io. Prevents AI/automation theme drift by giving every agent a machine-readable manifest to read BEFORE editing CSS.

canonical_source.rule: Any change to tokens.css MUST recompute this hash. The automated brand guardian rejects mismatches.

active_palette.label: Monochrome Operational Intelligence
active_palette.rationale: Migrated 2026-04-24 from oxblood to monochrome (commit 4d3ec9309 — 310 pages). Slate naming retained from earlier 1950s field-watch concept; visible aesthetic is dark monochrome + heraldic gold accent.

load_order_rule: FIXED. Other layers reference tokens via var(); they do NOT redefine :root. inline_generated.css MUST come last so CI can ship rule additions, never token redefinitions.

quantanium_namespace.purpose: Reserved --quantanium-* namespace: status-badge styling tokens. No live data source.

accessibility.purpose: Make the record readable for every IQ and reading ability — including dyslexic and low-vision readers — without stigma or visual contortion.
accessibility.primary_font_default: Atkinson Hyperlegible (Braille Institute, character-distinction sans). Locked as the only non-mono face site-wide per Daniel directive 2026-04-27.

accessible_reading_mode.rationale: Atkinson Hyperlegible was designed by the Braille Institute via low-vision research to differentiate commonly-misinterpreted characters (I/l/1, 0/O, b/d/p/q). Open-licensed via Google Fonts. Stronger empirical backing than OpenDyslexic for general dyslexia + low-vision readers; doubles as a beautiful reading font, eliminating the 'this is the disability mode' stigma.
accessible_reading_mode.tweaks: letter-spacing 0.01em, line-height 1.85, word-spacing 0.05em on body text

canonical.policy: Only place :root tokens are defined. !important is enforced.

legacy_aliases.policy: Forwarding only. Do NOT extend. Do NOT define new aliases. New code must reference canonical --slate-* names.

--slate-font-sans.use: body + UI + links — the only non-mono face on the site

--slate-font-mono.use: labels, eyebrows, citations, code, footer headers

--slate-font-serif.use: alias only — site uses no serif; slot maps to Atkinson

--slate-font-display.use: display headings — same face as body, weight differentiates

type_scale.policy: Fluid clamp() for the upper register (3xl–6xl), fixed rem for body sizes (xs–2xl).

rules_for_agents: READ /css/tokens.css §1 before adding any new :root token.
DO NOT add :root{} blocks to any file other than /css/tokens.css.
DO NOT introduce a new namespace prefix. Use --slate-* for canonical, alias forward in §2 if migrating an old name.
DO NOT remove !important from canonical tokens — it is the brute-force enforcement against auto-generation overwrites.
DO NOT migrate to oxblood, navy, red-ensign, or any palette other than monochrome-operational-intel without an explicit Daniel directive AND an update to active_palette.id here.
DO recompute canonical_source.sha256 after every edit to /css/tokens.css. tools/liril_brand_guardian rejects mismatches.
DO add new feature tokens to /css/tokens.css §1, then reference via var(--slate-...) in the feature's stylesheet.

checks: live tokens.css sha256 must equal canonical_source.sha256
no other production CSS file may declare :root tokens (audit pass)
monochrome palette signature: --slate-bg=#202020 must render in body computed style (live)

ci.pre_commit_hint: if /css/tokens.css changed, hash must be updated in this file in the same commit
